dax.title: FILTER over ALL pattern
dax.detail: This pattern can be expensive on large models. Review whether KEEPFILTERS, REMOVEFILTERS, or a narrower table expression is possible.

dax.title: Volatile date/time function
dax.detail: TODAY/NOW can make refresh and testing behavior time-dependent. Consider a governed date table or refresh parameter.

dax.title: EARLIER usage
dax.detail: EARLIER often indicates row-context complexity. Consider variables or a clearer calculation pattern.

dax.title: Inactive relationship activation
dax.detail: USERELATIONSHIP is valid, but report consumers may not understand the active date or role-playing dimension behavior.

powerQuery.title: Local file dependency
powerQuery.detail: Local file paths can break refresh in shared workspaces. Consider parameters, gateways, SharePoint, OneLake, or governed storage.

powerQuery.title: Table.Buffer usage
powerQuery.detail: Table.Buffer can help in narrow cases but can also increase memory pressure and block folding.
